    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # Track which cells have been "covered" by a maximal rectangle
    covered = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    
    for r in range(rows):

            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                continue
            
            # Found a new maximal rectangle starting at (r,c)
            val = grid[r][c]
            r1, r2, c1, c2 = r, r, r, c
            
            # Extend right
            while c2 + 1 < cols:

                # Check if entire row r1..r2 is solid at c2

                if not row_solid:

            # Extend down

                # Check if entire col c1..c2 is solid at r2
